review: none: AI-drafted. The method tests each skill with two or more independently drafted sets and reports the spread between them instead of reviewing each set by hand.

queries.query: 我想做一个新的 skill，用来把每周的 git commit 自动整理成周报，你帮我从头搭一个吧
queries.note: Explicitly asks to build a brand-new skill from nothing.

queries.query: turn what we just did into a skill — the whole flow of pulling the csv, cleaning columns and exporting to xlsx. start a new one called csv-cleaner
queries.note: Capture a workflow as a new skill; creation of a new skill directory.

queries.query: 帮我写个 SKILL.md，功能是审查 PR 里的 SQL 迁移文件有没有风险，还没有任何现成文件
queries.note: Writing a new SKILL.md with no existing material.

queries.query: i wanna make a skill for generating changelogs from conventional commits. can u interview me and then draft it?
queries.note: New skill creation including intent capture interview.

queries.query: 我的 pdf-fill skill 老是漏掉表单里的复选框，帮我改一下 skills/pdf-fill/SKILL.md 让它处理这种情况
queries.note: Modify an existing skill's instructions to fix a flaw.

queries.query: can you tighten up my deploy-helper skill? SKILL.md is like 700 lines and the model keeps ignoring the bottom half, split into references/
queries.note: Restructure and improve an existing skill using progressive disclosure.

queries.query: 上次用户反馈说 changelog skill 输出格式太啰嗦，根据反馈把它重写一版，别太多 MUST 那种硬规则
queries.note: Iterate on an existing skill based on user feedback.

queries.query: update my code-review skill so it also checks for missing tests, keep the rest as is
queries.note: Targeted edit of an existing skill.

queries.query: 我写好了 resume-parser 这个 skill，帮我造 3 个测试 prompt 跑一下，看看带 skill 和不带 skill 输出差多少
queries.clause: Run evals to test a skill
queries.note: Create test prompts and run with-skill vs baseline evals.

queries.query: run the evals for my sql-lint skill and open the viewer so i can leave feedback on each output
queries.clause: Run evals to test a skill
queries.note: Run eval cases and launch the review viewer.

queries.query: 帮我给 evals/evals.json 里的用例加断言，然后对 xlsx-report 这个 skill 跑一轮评测并打分
queries.clause: Run evals to test a skill
queries.note: Add assertions and grade an eval run.

queries.query: test my new skill on a few realistic prompts and compare against the old version before i ship it
queries.clause: Run evals to test a skill
queries.note: Eval run comparing against old skill snapshot.

queries.query: 把 iteration-2 的结果聚合成 benchmark，我要看 pass rate 的均值和标准差，还有 token 和耗时对比
queries.note: Aggregate benchmark with mean ± stddev.

queries.query: each eval ran 3 times for my skill, which assertions are flaky or non-discriminating? do an analyst pass on the benchmark.json
queries.note: Analyze variance and flaky assertions in benchmark data.

queries.query: 对比 with_skill 和 baseline 的稳定性，多跑几次看方差，别只看一次结果
queries.note: Repeated runs for variance of skill performance.

queries.query: benchmark my skill's performance — need pass_rate delta vs without_skill plus time/token tradeoff in a table
queries.note: Quantitative benchmark with deltas.

queries.query: 我这个 skill 老是不被触发，帮我优化一下 description，让它触发更准
queries.note: Improve description for triggering accuracy.

queries.query: run the description optimizer on my pdf-tools skill, it undertriggers when people just say 'merge these pdfs'
queries.note: Run description improvement loop for undertriggering.

queries.query: 帮我造一批 should-trigger 和 should-not-trigger 的查询，测一下 frontmatter 里 description 的触发率
queries.note: Trigger eval set to tune description.

queries.query: my skill's description is too vague, claude never picks it. make it pushier and test whether it fires on the right prompts
queries.note: Rewrite description and verify triggering.

queries.query: 帮我写一个 Python 脚本，批量把 skills 目录下每个 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 里的 name 字段转成小写
queries.note: Generic file-processing script, not improving a skill's behavior.

queries.query: how do i install a skill from github into ~/.claude/skills? just need the command
queries.note: Installing an existing skill, not creating one; skill-finder/installer territory.

queries.query: 帮我写个 slash command，输入 /deploy 就跑 npm run build 然后 rsync 到服务器
queries.note: Slash command/script, not a skill.

queries.query: write unit tests for my parse_config function in utils.py using pytest
queries.clause: Run evals to test a skill
queries.note: Ordinary code testing, not skill evaluation.

queries.query: 帮我给我们的 RAG 检索接口跑个评测，算 recall@10 和 MRR，数据在 eval/qrels.tsv
queries.clause: Run evals to test a skill
queries.note: Evaluating a retrieval system, not a skill.

queries.query: benchmark my sorting function against numpy.sort across array sizes, give me mean and stddev of runtime
queries.note: Code performance benchmarking, not skill benchmarking.

queries.query: 我们 A/B 测试的转化率数据在 ab.csv，帮我算一下置信区间和方差，看显著不显著
queries.note: Statistical analysis of unrelated data.

queries.query: optimize the meta description and title tag on my landing page index.html for SEO
queries.note: SEO description, not a skill's description.

queries.query: 帮我优化这段 prompt，让 GPT 更稳定地输出 JSON，不用管什么 skill
queries.note: General prompt engineering, not skill triggering.

queries.query: review my pull request diff and suggest improvements to the error handling in src/api/client.ts
queries.note: Code review of ordinary source, not editing a skill.

clauses: Run evals to test a skill
